components.name: SiteHeader
components.usage: Use for shared public navigation with member access and labeled social links in the mobile menu.
antipatterns: Do not force desktop navigation into tablet widths.

components.name: SiteFooter
components.usage: Use once at the bottom of each page for shared navigation and official social destinations.
antipatterns: Do not replace official social links with placeholder destinations.

components.name: SocialLinks
components.usage: Use official social icons in footers; use the labeled variant in mobile navigation. Links open in another tab.
antipatterns: Do not use social buttons to trigger internal navigation.
Do not replace the provided destination URLs.
